items.caption: A modern redraw of an open frame crossed by netting lines, illustrating the net pictograph described for oracle-bone forms.
items.alt: Open, roughly rectangular outline with crossing diagonal strokes and long outer strokes on both sides.
items.selection_reason: Its visible structure helps explain the reported analysis of 网 as a spread net. The redraw is not itself an attested inscription.

items.caption: A modern redraw of the seal-script form, with crossed lines inside an enclosed frame and long sides extending downward.
items.alt: Rounded enclosed frame with crossed diagonal lines in the upper portion and long descending sides.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the Shuowen account of a frame and crossed net threads; it does not establish a direct sequence from the other image.

limitations.text: Both images are modern redrawings rather than photographs or direct scans of ancient objects. The cited account does not assign absolute dates to the reported oracle-bone examples.
